The [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] '''Vanish 2 Military Sensor Masking System''' was a military grade [[Sensor mask (starship technology)|sensor mask]] that could be installed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of nearly any size. The system used electromagnetic and [[holograph]]ic transmitters to make the ship blend into the background of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. The system was extremely effective, but was also expensive to apply to an entire vessel.

The Vanish 2 worked like most sensor masks - when activated, the device monitored the sensor conditions around the ship such as [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], communications signals, and visible light, and then re-emitted these signals instantly on the other side of the ship. This fooled sensor scans into seeing a single and uninterrupted section of space - and allowed ships to operate extremely close to sensors and scanners without being detected.
